evidence: Tam Velo Club's 2026 weekly rides page still lists the Sunday ride (meet 9:30, roll 9:35, Equator Coffees at Proof Lab, 25-35 miles) but describes a 14-17 mph moderate pace, not a beginner pace, and does not promise no-drop.

changes.pace: moderate, 14–17 mph averages across the ride; not a beginner pace
changes.description: Marin's community cycling club runs a shorter Sunday ride from Equator Coffees in Mill Valley. Moderate pace, 25 to 35 miles, 14 to 17 mph averages. Not a beginner pace. The leader sets the route and pace to the people who show up. The club does not promise no-drop. A longer, faster ride leaves from the same spot on Saturdays at 8:30 am.
changes.visitor_notes: Posts go to the club's Telegram group (link on the weekly rides page). Waiver and helmet required. The page says to be ready to ride back alone if you get separated from the group. Rain cancels.
